item.projecthero.keycard.use: Use it on that place's Blast Doors.
item.projecthero.keycard.blank: A blank master card: opens any Blast Door.
item.projecthero.keycard.wrong: This keycard belongs to another place.
block.projecthero.blast_door.locked: Locked. The Captain of %s carries the keycard.
block.projecthero.blast_door.sealed: Sealed by the alarm. Beat the reinforcements or use the keycard.
block.projecthero.alarm_panel.alert: Too late: the alarm is already going.
block.projecthero.alarm_panel.suspicious: Someone is watching. You can only sabotage it while it is calm.
block.projecthero.alarm_panel.sabotaged: Panel sabotaged: the sensors wired to it are dead.
projecthero.alarm.runner: A guard is running for the alarm panel!
projecthero.alarm.raised.sensor: ALARM! A sensor tripped and %s is on alert.
projecthero.alarm.wave_cleared: Wave beaten: the Blast Doors open. More are coming.
projecthero.alarm.waves_done: Reinforcements beaten. Stay out of sight and it will calm down.
projecthero.alarm.ghost: Ghost! Nobody raised the alarm: one extra vault roll.
advancement.projecthero.ghost.title: Ghost
advancement.projecthero.ghost.descriptio: Open a guarded place's vault without its alarm ever going off
projecthero.guide.structures.alarms: Guarded places (Tier 2 sites, villain hideouts and dungeons) run an alarm system: sneak past the guards or the whole place goes on alert. See Loot & Progression.
projecthero.guide.loot.alarms.body: Every guarded place is an alarm zone. Guards see you in a cone in front of them, up to 16 blocks away: 8 while you sneak, 4 while you are invisible, and half that again in the dark. A guard that sees you gets suspicious (a yellow "?") and turns to look; keep watching it and it goes "!", shouts for its friends and the Alarm Runner sprints for the nearest Alarm Panel. Walking right behind a guard is heard too, so sneak. A small eye near the top of the screen shows the zone's state.
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_state.suspi: Suspicious: a guard is looking, or a fight has started but nobody has reached a panel yet. Kill the runner!
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_state.alert: Alert: a siren, red lamps, the Blast Doors slam shut and two waves of reinforcements arrive. Beat them, then stay out of sight for a minute and it calms down (sabotaged panels stay dead).
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_block.alarm: Alarm Panel: what the runner runs to. While the place is calm, hold right-click on it for 3 seconds to sabotage it: it dies for good, and so do the sensors wired to it (the ones nearer to it than to any other panel).
Alarm Lamp: dark until the alarm goes off, then red (or a burning brazier in old places).
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_block.blast: Blast Door: shuts on Alert and opens again when a reinforcement wave dies. Locked ones need the place's keycard.
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_block.secur: Security Camera: sweeps from side to side; a second in its red view wedge raises the alarm. Breaking a live one trips it.
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_block.laser: Laser Tripwire: a red beam across a corridor. Jump a knee-high beam, crouch under a head-high one.
projecthero.guide.loot.alarm_block.keyca: Keycard: dropped by the place's Captain. Opens that place's Blast Doors, even during an alert.
projecthero.guide.loot.roles.body: Some guards have a job, shown by their name tag when you look at them:
projecthero.guide.loot.role.captain: Captain (gold helmet): carries the keycard and makes guards within 8 blocks hit 20% harder. One per place.
projecthero.guide.loot.role.runner: Alarm Runner: fast and lightly armoured. Once anyone spots you he runs for a panel and won't fight while one is reachable. Kill him first.
projecthero.guide.loot.role.medic: Medic: heals hurt guards near it every couple of seconds. A priority target.
projecthero.guide.loot.role.shield: Shield-bearer: blocks 70% of damage from the front. Hit it from the side or behind, or knock the shield away with an axe or one big hit.
projecthero.guide.loot.role.sniper: Sniper: sits on perches; a red laser line shows who it is aiming at, then a slow heavy shot. Break line of sight.
projecthero.guide.loot.ghost.body: Open a place's vault without its alarm ever having gone off and you get one extra roll on the vault's loot, plus the Ghost advancement. Once per player per place.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.body: Five villain factions each run a hideout somewhere in the world: Tier 3 places, rarer than the old sites and far more dangerous. Each one is a 10-15 minute crawl over several levels, with guards that never despawn, alarms, traps, a Captain with the keycard and a mini-boss guarding the faction's Hideout Core. A Hideout Locator (from Site Vaults) points to the nearest one.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.crawl.body: Outer defences first: guard posts, a sniper perch and the first Alarm Panel with its runner. Then a stairwell down into the inner level: a checkpoint with a second panel and a Shield-bearer, a trap gauntlet (laser or string tripwires, vents, an arrow crossfire), and the Captain's quarters with a Medic, a runner and a sniper on the mezzanine. The Captain's keycard opens the Blast Door into the mini-boss arena (a third panel waits at the back), and behind the arena lies the sealed vault room with the core.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.clearing.body: The Hideout Core in the vault room behind the arena is sealed while the mini-boss lives: nothing can break it. Kill the mini-boss and the seal drops; break the core and the hideout is cleared for good. The sealed Hideout Vault beside it then opens into a Tier 3 Hero Vault, and every player gets their own share (plus the Ghost bonus if the alarm never went off).
projecthero.guide.hideouts.traps.body: Laser tripwires, sweeping cameras and tripwires hooked to the faction's alarm (siren boxes, egg pods, war horns) raise the alarm when you set them off; sabotage the panel they are wired to and they go dead. Some floors hide pressure plates that fire arrows from the walls, and vents that hiss for a moment, then erupt: step off fast.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.mini_bosses.b: Every mini-boss has a boss bar, turns on whoever is hurting it most, and gets a second phase at half health (the bar turns red) with a new attack: the Enforcer's Bull Rush, the Overseer's Plasma Mines, the Commander's Firebomb Run, the Hive Mother's Biomass Eruption and the Jarl's Ice Spike line and blizzard. They always drop Vibranium Shards, with a 1 in 4 chance of a Dungeon Locator.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.kingpin.bod: "Fisk Imports", a brick pawn shop with a warehouse and a fenced back lot (a guard booth with the first panel, a water tower with a sniper). A trapdoor behind the counter drops to the back offices and the counting room, where a stairwell leads down to the inner level and Kingpin's Enforcer's fight club. Mini-boss: Kingpin's Enforcer, a huge brute who charges, throws a jab-jab-uppercut combo, stomps the floor and calls his boys; at under half health he goes Untouchable and Bull Rushes three times in a row.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.ultron.body: A bunker sunk into a mountainside: entrance hall (first panel), an assembly hall of half-built robots, a drone bay and the control room, with a turret nest on the roof. A stairwell leads down to the Deep Forge. Mini-boss: the Forge Overseer, which fires homing missiles, stamps the ground, sweeps a slow red Overload Beam (break line of sight) and deploys drones; at half health it overclocks and scatters Plasma Mines.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.apokolips.b: A scorched crater with fire pits and basalt sniper perches round a dark tower (barracks and a strategy room up the ladders). A stairwell in the gate floor leads down to the Fire Pits. Mini-boss: the Parademon Commander, who fires a fan of bolts, dives on you from above and opens Boom Tubes for reinforcements; at half health he calls an Air Raid of firebombs in a line.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.symbiote.bo: A sinkhole leads deep underground into a dripping cave hive: a great chamber, a nursery of egg pods and a den, then down again into the overgrown Brood Lab. Mini-boss: the Hive Mother, a towering host who lashes and drags you with tendrils, fires black spikes and births infested spiders; at half health she frenzies and makes black spikes erupt under everyone.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.frost.body: A Norse longhall of dark timber and blue ice, with a long fire, side benches, a raised throne and a log watchtower outside. Beside the throne a stairwell leads down to the Jarl's Barrow, whose wards are rune stones and braziers. Mini-boss: the Frost Giant Jarl, who cleaves in a wide arc, plants his sword to send a ring of ice spikes outward (jump them) and rallies his warriors; at half health a blizzard rises and lines of ice spikes march at you.
projecthero.jei.alarm.system: Part of the alarm system that guards Tier 2 sites, villain hideouts and dungeons. See the Guidebook: Loot & Progression, Alarms and stealth.
projecthero.jei.alarm.alarm_panel: Alarm Panel: guards run to it to raise the alarm. Hold right-click on it for 3 seconds while the place is calm to sabotage it (it and its sensors die for good).
projecthero.jei.alarm.alarm_lamp: Alarm Lamp: lights up red while its place is on alert.
projecthero.jei.alarm.blast_door: Blast Door: shuts on alert, opens when a reinforcement wave dies. Locked doors need the place's Keycard.
projecthero.jei.alarm.security_camera: Security Camera: sweeps side to side; a second in its view raises the alarm. Dead once its panel is sabotaged.
projecthero.jei.alarm.laser_tripwire: Laser Tripwire: crossing its beam raises the alarm. Jump low beams, crouch under high ones.
projecthero.jei.alarm.alarm_spawn_point: An invisible marker where alarm reinforcements arrive (for builders).
projecthero.jei.alarm.keycard: Keycard: dropped by a place's Captain. Opens that place's Blast Doors.
